conbody.p: It is important to use the correct trailer hitch equipment. Crosswinds, large trucks nearby, and rough roads are a few reasons why you need the right hitch. Follow these rules:

li.p: If you have to make any holes in the body of your vehicle when you install a trailer hitch, be sure to seal the holes after you remove the hitch. If you do not seal the holes, deadly carbon monoxide (CO) from your exhaust, as well as dirt and water, can enter your vehicle.
The bumpers on your vehicle are not intended for trailer hitches. Do not attach rental hitches or other bumper-type hitches. Only use a frame-mounted hitch that does not attach to the bumper.
A Kia trailer hitch accessory is available at an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
